target_customer: Robotics companies and manufacturers that need dexterous, force aware human demonstration data to train robot policies
problem: Video demonstrations miss the force and effort of human hands, limiting dexterous robot learning. Axonnic records skilled workers with a forearm EMG sleeve plus video and hand tracking to capture those signals.
business_model: Data and training service for robot policies, pricing not public
product_category: Robotics training data via wearable EMG

founders.name: Maxim Williams
prior_employers: Voxblock (early employee, PCB development, supply chain, Series A)
founders.background_notes: Company site says his Oxford research was in signal processing.

founders.name: Arsh Patankar
prior_employers: OxRAM (control software for a quadruped robot)
founders.background_notes: Published clinical research and built Medical Advice GPT, per the YC page.

competitors.name: Hemlock
competitors.what: Wristband reading forearm muscle activity to estimate force for robot data
competitors.traction_then: Claims a tenfold improvement on an egg pick and place task, no absolute numbers

technical_complexity.rationale: Requires custom EMG sensing hardware, calibration across users, and policies that transfer to robots without the sleeve. Academic work (ForceBand, 2026) shows cross user generalization is still hard.

defensibility.rationale: Data could compound, but at least two rival EMG efforts launched in the same period and the data benefit is not yet quantified.

market_need_then: Robotics labs are seeking dexterous manipulation data; the company reports a letter of intent from a European manufacturer for force sensitive sewing and a construction pilot. No paying customers are named.

branding.domain_note: Company uses axonnic.com, an exact match .com.

identity.voice_and_tone: Tagline: Creating human skill at robot scale.

branding.brand_signature: The tagline Human skill at robot scale
branding.community_and_virality: Launched on Product Hunt with about 51 followers; covered in a Fondo blog post.

brand_strength.rationale: Distinctive invented name and a clear tagline with some launch coverage, but small audience and confusable with Axonics.

outcome_analysis: Axonnic is an Active Fall 2026 YC company with Oxford founders and four named backers but no disclosed amounts. It has a letter of intent and a construction pilot, no paying customers named, and direct EMG rivals launching at the same time. Outcome is open.
notes: Backers come from the company's own site; stage, date and amounts are not stated, so the round is typed other with null date. Wetour Robotics (sEMG plus vision, announced September 2026) is also a rival but its press URL was truncated, so it is not listed. Outcome search returned only Axonics, an unrelated company. Founded year not found.
